reason: I already have my Toplux and I just reorder it when it runs out, I'm not hunting for something new. $29.99 is more than what I pay now, and I'm too tired to switch and research a new thing.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I have no reason to pay extra for a brand I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: A price at or under what I pay now, plus a creator I trust showing it actually helps me sleep better than what I take.
